title: "Join Us!"

---

<div class="join-section">

If you're interested in joining us, send an email to **Lukas.Schrader[at]uni-muenster.de**. 

Projects should regard open evolutionary or ecological questions that can be addressed using:
- Population genomics
- Comparative analyses
- Molecular biology
- Field work
- Behavioral experiments

We offer a friendly and supportive research environment focused on understanding the evolution of genomes and their role in adaptive evolution, primarily in ants.

</div>
